description_excerpt: Job Description 1. Business Development & Sales: • Market research, identify potential projects/ Clients and develop project pipelines related to IND-inspection service in Energy & Utilities segment. • Prepare marketing material, sales kit for sales activities (Brochures, presentation, service capability, price list, gift initiative, etc…) • Proactively approach Owners, EPCs, Manufacturers, and Contractors to promote SGS' IND inspection capabilities. • Understand Client technical requirements and translate them into commercial proposals and scopes of work. • Prepare and submit quotations,…
benefits: Competitive compensation package (including base salary and allowances);
Holiday bonuses for major public holidays and birthday gift;
Annual leaves: 18 days / year, sick leaves;
Full participation in social, health and unemployment insurance in accordance with Vietnamese Labor law;
